facts.fact: Mozambique's Assembly of the Republic approved in first reading, by consensus, on 16 March 2022 the Council of Ministers' bill setting the legal regime for civil identification and the national citizen identity card (Bilhete de Identidade), to replace colonial-era legislation; the item does not say the bill was later promulgated.
facts.system: Regime Jurídico de Identificação Civil e do Bilhete de Identidade do Cidadão Nacional

systems.country_label: Bilhete de Identidade (biometric identity card, Decree 11/2008 of 29 April)
